title: Beyond the Horizon
summary: The playable Strait now sits inside a much larger natural landscape: continuous Zagros and Musandam mountain ranges surround the camera, coastlines follow the real shipping corridor more closely, sparse irrigated greenery breaks up the desert, and convoys travel through long visible approaches instead of disappearing at the battlefield edge.

title: The Real Strait, Reimagined
summary: The rectangular prototype terrain has been replaced by smooth low-poly geography inspired by the real Strait of Hormuz: sculpted Iranian and Musandam coastlines, Qeshm, Hormuz, Larak and Hengam islands, turquoise shallows, and restrained faceted mountain chains.

title: Reinforcements Ashore
summary: A new Simple Military asset library upgrades U.S. tanks, Iranian SCUD launchers, radar vehicles, and drones. U.S. commanders gain a paid attack-helicopter sortie, while sandbags, damaged buildings, palms, walls, guard positions, and rubble make both shores feel battle-worn.

title: Autonomous Command
summary: AI vs AI observation mode lets both factions build, upgrade, launch sorties, and fight while you control the spectator camera. AI-involved matches now produce structured local training records, and fixed grid defenses are protected from physics displacement.

title: Shore Defense Redesign
summary: Two 8×5 deployment grids, fixed shore defenses, oil-rig income, automatic convoy waves, cargo upgrades, and route-drawn warplane and drone sorties are now playable. New Simple Port ships and harbor props bring the Strait to life.

title: First Contact
summary: The initial solo-versus-AI battle established convoy scoring, command economies, asymmetric faction rosters, fog of war, and a compressed Strait of Hormuz battlefield.
